title: DC-DC Voltage Controller
text: PID-based power factor correction (PFC) rectifier controller, 5 inputs, 2 outputs; {System frequency (Hz)}, {AC filter inductance (H)} sets the aC filter inductance 1e-4, {AC side base impedance (Ohm)} sets the aC-side base impedance, {PLL proportional gain} sets the proportional gain, {PLL integral gain} sets the integral gain, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Proportional gain}, {Integral gain}, {Derivative gain}, {Derivative controller filter coefficient (N)}, {DC bus base voltage (V)}, {Controller output upper limit (pu)}, {Controller output lower limit (pu)}, {Id proportional gain}, {Id integral gain}, {Id derivative gain}, {Id controller output upper limit (pu)}, {Id controller output lower limit (pu)}, {Iq proportional gain}, {Iq integral gain}, {Iq derivative gain}, {Derivative current controller filter coefficient (N)}, {Iq controller output upper limit (pu)} and {Iq controller output lower limit (pu)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: VdcRef (V)
ports.summary: Output DC-link voltage reference, V scalar

ports.summary: Measured AC phase voltage, pu vector
